🎃[HALLOWS UPDATE] NEW KRISS VECTOR, NEW MAP, SKINS AND MORE!

📱💻🎮 Now available in every platform! (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)

💎 VIP servers are free for everyone!

Successor to ENGINE TESTING [II]

BESIEGED is an ARCADE WAVE SURVIVAL SHOOTER built on the ET [II] engine. Battle through relentless hordes of unique enemies across a variety of maps, each with their own mechanics, enemy types, and powerful bosses. Earn rewards, unlock new gear, and customize your loadout with a vast collection of weapons, attachments, charms, and skins as you push deeper into increasingly challenging waves.

⭐ If you enjoy the game or have feedback to share, please leave a like or dislike and use Roblox's feedback feature to tell us what you think!

❓ Have questions, suggestions, or appeals? Want to see sneak peeks of upcoming content? Join the communications server!
